# The shape of the register

Generated by `bin/validate.py --write-dist`. Not hand-edited.

## Rank structure

Every membership edge, collapsed to the level of the things it connects.
Edge labels are edge counts; node labels are how many entities exist at that
level. A level with no path upward is a break in the graph.

```mermaid
graph BT
  clan["clan<br/>1"]
  community["community<br/>1"]
  ecotype["ecotype<br/>2"]
  individual["individual<br/>740"]
  matriline["matriline<br/>274"]
  pod["pod<br/>3"]
  taxon["taxon<br/>56"]
  individual -->|983| matriline
  matriline -->|132| ecotype
  matriline -->|116| matriline
  matriline -->|26| pod
  individual -->|23| pod
  individual -->|3| ecotype
  pod -->|3| clan
  ecotype -->|2| taxon
  clan -->|1| community
  community -->|1| ecotype
```
